newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Aug 27.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Aug 27.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers were steady on Tuesday, but weaker indications on the cargo market and a slight decline in paper levels could indicate some weakenss to come. Bunker 380-cst was flat at $105/$108 and 180-cst was a shade lower at $109/$111 in line with a decline in cargos. MDO and gas oil were steady at $186/$191 and $200/$205 respectively.
